presentation.label: QPERF
presentation.summary: Set performance locks by holding QPER and turning knobs, apply them to the kit, and record performance moves in LIVE RECORDING.
presentation.overview: Hold QPER and turn a knob: it edits that parameter's offset in the performance linked to QPER, and the knob inverts and shows it as it does for a held performance pad. QPER + PLAY clears it and PLAY again undoes that. QPER + RECORD and STOP copy and paste it. QPER + YES writes what you hear into the kit and removes those locks. In LIVE RECORDING the pads, the QPER knob and MIDI performance moves are kept in a quick perf rec that loops with the pattern; RECORD + YES writes it into the pattern as locks, RECORD + NO clears it.
highlights: Sets a lock in the linked performance with one turn
QPER + PLAY clears the linked performance
QPER + YES moves them into the kit
Records pad and QPER knob moves in LIVE RECORDING and plays them back, 8 points a step
usage: Link a performance with QPER + a pad, hold QPER and turn knobs to shape one macro on the QPER knob.
Sweep the QPER knob, then QPER + YES when a sound is worth keeping.
In LIVE RECORDING, squeeze performance pads while the pattern plays; RECORD + YES writes the moves into the pattern as locks.

access.location: The QPER key, on the sound pages and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO.
steps: Hold QPER and press a pad to link that one performance.
Keep QPER held and turn a knob to set its offset.
QPER + PLAY clears the linked performance; press PLAY again to undo. QPER + RECORD copies it, QPER + STOP pastes.
QPER + YES moves them into the kit.
In PERF mode, hold RECORD and press PLAY, then play the pads: the moves loop. RECORD + YES writes them into the pattern; RECORD + NO empties them, NO again undoes.

limitations: A press with QPER held leaves one link, unlike stock. A kit with several keeps them until then, and shows MORE THAN ONE LINKED.
The gestures work on the sound pages and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO, not in menus.
Until the QPER knob moves after power on, QPER + YES uses the amounts stock holds.
Replaces stock's QPER + PLAY, which starts the sequencer.
Recorded performance moves live in RAM until QPER + YES writes them: a pattern change, project load or power off drops them.
The move lane holds 64 steps; a track at its own speed gets no locks from it.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

tests.summary: Run on the author's Analog Rytm MKII and in rytm-emu. TESTING.md names each build.
